title: AI Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
description:
We're Hiring: Backend Engineer (HMS) – MedOrbit, an AI-Native Hospital Platform

This isn't a "maintain a CRUD app" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals, runs the full clinical and operational spine of a hospital, and has 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll build the backend that doctors, nurses, lab technicians, pharmacists and billing teams use every day.

Role Details

Position: Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)

Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On-site, 5 days a week)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years

Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred

Mandatory: Hands-on experience developing a Hospital Management System (HMS), EHR/EMR, LIS, pharmacy or other healthcare software (job, internship or substantial project)

About MedOrbit

MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One codebase serves 24 facility types, from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500-bed super-specialty hospital, pathology labs, imaging centres, dialysis chains, blood banks and retail pharmacies.

It covers OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, telemedicine, pharmacy, billing, revenue-cycle management and insurance / TPA. It is ABDM-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4), NHCX-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and supports NABH/NABL evidence and DPDP compliance.

What You'll Do

1️⃣ Core HMS Modules

→ Build and extend Java / Spring Boot microservices across patient registration, appointments, OPD/IPD workflows, bed management, lab orders, pharmacy inventory, billing and insurance claims

→ Design REST APIs and database schemas that work across 24 facility types without forking the codebase

→ Implement module licensing and multi-tenant data isolation so each hospital sees only what it has licensed

2️⃣ Healthcare Integrations

→ Work on ABDM flows: ABHA creation/linking, consent management, HIP/HIU data exchange

→ Build and maintain FHIR R4 resources, HL7 messages from lab analysers, and DICOM integration with PACS

→ Support NHCX claim submission and TPA workflows

3️⃣ AI Integration

→ Integrate Python-based AI services (ambient scribe, lab report intelligence, X-ray analysis, claim-denial guard) into the core platform

→ Build the APIs, queues and audit trails that let AI outputs appear inside doctor workflows, with clinician approval recorded every time

4️⃣ Reliability & Compliance

→ Write unit and integration tests, review code, and fix production issues quickly

→ Build audit logs, role-based access control, consent tracking and data-erasure features for DPDP and NABH compliance

→ Optimise queries and APIs for hospitals with high daily patient volumes

Tech Stack

Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Python (AI services), Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD

What You Bring

Must-Have:

→ B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)

→ Hands-on experience building an HMS, EHR/EMR, LIS, RIS, pharmacy or clinic management system. Be ready to walk us through the modules you built, the database design, and the problems you solved

→ Strong fundamentals in Java and Spring Boot

→ Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, joins, indexing and data modelling

→ Understanding of hospital workflows: patient registration → consultation → orders → billing → discharge

→ Working knowledge of Git, Docker and Linux

→ Clear communication – you'll work with doctors and hospital staff, not just engineers

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points!):

→ Exposure to FHIR, HL7, DICOM, ABDM, LOINC or ICD codes

→ Microservices architecture, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Redis caching

→ AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and CI/CD pipelines

→ Experience with insurance/TPA billing or GST-compliant invoicing

→ Basic Python or experience integrating ML/LLM services

→ Frontend exposure (React / Angular) for full-stack debugging

How We Work

Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and features are validated with real hospital users, not in a conference room.

Why Join AI Nexus?

✅ Build a live HMS used by real hospitals from Day 1

✅ Work on India's healthcare digital stack: ABDM, FHIR, NHCX

✅ See how AI agents are built into a production hospital platform

✅ Fast-track career growth in a high-potential health-tech startup

title: 3. Forge and harden backend APIs for the agent
description:
**About Briskk AI – The World You're Entering**

Most serious purchase decisions in India don't happen on a website. They happen through
**conversations**
– on WhatsApp or in-store with staff.

Yet high-ticket, online-and-store brands still run on:

* Leaky funnels between
  **WhatsApp, store visits, and websites**
* Staff trying to remember every walk-in and follow-up
* CRMs that don't understand SKUs, carts, or real conversations
* Stateless, rule-based chatbots that can blast offers but can't
  **close**

**Briskk AI**
is building a
**WhatsApp-native commerce revenue engine**
for online-and-store, high-ticket retail (starting with furniture on Shopify).

On top of Shopify + in-store data, we run
**two agents on a shared brain**
:

* 🛒
  **Customer Agent**
  – helps end customers search, compare, and ask about products directly on WhatsApp.
* 🧑‍💼
  **Staff Agent**
  – lets store staff capture, qualify, and update leads (with full product context) from the same thread.

One shared state, two agents,
**zero excuses for lost leads**
.

We've already:

* Built a
  **multi-tenant Elixir/Phoenix + Postgres (JSONB, FTS, pgvector) + Redis**
  platform
* Cloned the Shopify data model on our side
* Wired it into a real
  **WhatsApp agent**
  that runs end-to-end demos on live furniture catalogs
* Live with paying furniture brands, handling thousands of WhatsApp conversations and generating revenue across customer + staff interactions

Now we're pushing from
**working product → undeniable revenue impact → PMF and seed round.**

You'll join exactly at this inflection point.

**The Quest – Your Role**

This is not a pure ML research role and not a simple backend CRUD role. You'll sit at the intersection of:

* **Applied LLM systems**
  – tools, workflows, evals, guardrails
* **Backend & data infra**
  – APIs, Postgres/pgvector, Redis, multi-tenant state
* **Commerce domain**
  – Shopify, carts, orders, leads, staff workflows

Your mission:

Turn our current agents into a
**reliable, measurable revenue engine**
that D2C brands can't imagine turning off.

You'll work directly with the founder (ex-Coinbase, ex-Walmart, ex-Urban Ladder) and:

* Own the
  **LLM workflows**
  that power customer + staff conversations
* Own the
  **search & ranking stack**
  combining FTS + pgvector
* Own the
  **reliability, latency, and observability**
  of the WhatsApp agent in production

This is a
**founding team**
seat – you are not joining as "employee #27", you're helping define the product, the stack, and the culture.

**Quests You'll Undertake**

**1. Design and build agentic workflows (Two Agents, One Brain)**

* • Architect and own the core logic for the
  **Customer Agent**
  and
  **Staff Agent**
* • Intent detection and routing between
  **product mode**
  and
  **lead/CRM mode**
* • Multi-step tool usage (product search, inventory, pricing, lead update, etc.)
* • Conversation state and memory (Redis, JSON state/frames, tenant-aware context)
* • Use OpenAI (and similar) APIs to design robust prompts and
  **structured outputs / tools**
* • Minimize hallucinations and brittle flows
* • Control latency and token usage like a performance engineer
* • Build
  **evaluation harnesses**
  for critical intents with automated scoring

**2. Own the hybrid search & ranking engine**

* • Implement and tune
  **Postgres text search**
  (tsvector, ts\_rank\_cd, trigram similarity)
* • Extend and optimize
  **pgvector**
  for semantic and "similar items" search
* • Hybrid pipeline: keyword filter → vector rerank
* • Latency-conscious design that stays under a strict p95 budget
* • Expose clean, composable APIs for natural language discovery

**3. Forge and harden backend APIs for the agent**

* • Extend our
  **Elixir/Phoenix + Postgres + Redis**
  stack
* • Design and implement APIs for product search, lead management, and staff workflows
* • Keep the system secure, multi-tenant, and predictable under real-world traffic

**4. Make the AI truly production-grade**

* • Instrument everything with
  **metrics and logs**
  (p50/p95 latency, error rates)
* • Create
  **dashboards and runbooks**
  for production systems
* • Track metrics that actually matter: leads created, qualified, closed, conversion rates

**Target:**
≤2.5s p95 response time end-to-end on WhatsApp across catalogs of 5k–50k SKUs per tenant

**What success looks like in your first 90 days**

30

**Days**

You understand our current agent flows, ship fixes to the top 2–3 reliability/latency issues, and help shape evaluation harness v1.

60

**Days**

You own a slice of the stack (e.g., hybrid search or lead APIs) and ship a visible v2 with better p95 and debuggability.

90

**Days**

You're the clear owner for at least one core area (search, lead flows, or eval/observability), and we can see your work reflected in production metrics.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

You don't have to tick every box, but this describes you reasonably well:

**You're likely a strong fit if you've:**

* ✓ Shipped at least one LLM-powered workflow with tools / structured outputs into production
* ✓ Owned Postgres performance on real traffic (indexes, EXPLAIN, query tuning)
* ✓ Worked on systems where p95 latency and reliability actually mattered

**Required Experience:**

* •
  **4–9 years**
  in backend / platform / applied ML/AI roles
* • Strong in at least one backend language (Elixir/Phoenix ideal, or Python/FastAPI, Node.js, Go)
* • Deep comfort with
  **Postgres**
  (query design, indexes, JSONB, full-text search)
* • Hands-on experience with
  **Redis**
  (key spaces, TTL strategies, caching)
* • Real experience building
  **LLM-powered applications**
  with OpenAI/Claude
* • Think in terms of
  **latency and reliability**
  (p50/p95, retries, timeouts)
* •
  **Product-minded**
  : care about what gets brands more leads and sales

**Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points):**

* • Experience with
  **Shopify Admin API**
  or other commerce platforms
* • Prior work in
  **conversational commerce**
  or CRM/lead management tools
* • Experience with
  **pgvector**
  or other vector databases
* • Prior
  **early-stage startup**
  or founding-team experience

**Your Arsenal (Stack)**

**Backend**

* • Elixir/Phoenix, Oban
* • Python/FastAPI for agent services

**Database**

* • Postgres (JSONB, FTS, pgvector)
* • Redis

**AI/LLM**

* • OpenAI (GPT-class models)
* • Structured outputs / tools
* • Eval harnesses

**Integrations**

* • Shopify Admin API
* • WhatsApp Business API/BSPs

**Infrastructure**

* • Docker, AWS (EC2/RDS/Redis), GitHub Actions CI/CD

**How We Work**

* • Tiny team,
  **high-bandwidth collaboration**
  with the founder
* • Tight feedback loop with paying customers (live in
  **furniture retail**
  )
* • Preference for
  **small, frequent releases**
  over big-bang refactors
* • You'll be involved in architecture, design discussions, and customer calls

**We care about:**

* •
  **Clarity:**
  simple designs, simple APIs, clear ownership
* •
  **Reliability:**
  things should work, not just look good in a demo
* •
  **Speed:**
  deciding and shipping in days, not quarters

**Compensation & Upside**

We're
**pre-seed and pre-PMF**
, but with paying customers and thousands of conversations.

We'll be upfront:

We
**cannot**
match Big Tech or late-stage startup salaries right now. Cash is constrained until we scale revenue beyond furniture and close our first round.

**What we can offer:**

* **Cash:**
  Lower than Big Tech / late-stage startup to begin with, with room to step up as revenue lands. Options include:
  + • A modest fixed base, plus project / goal-based incentives, or
  + • A contract-to-hire path for 2–3 months, then stepping up as revenue scales
* **Equity:**
  Meaningful upside as part of the founding team (roughly
  **1–2.5% ESOP range**
  for this seat, with milestone-based top-ups possible as we scale)
  + • Standard 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff
* **Upside path:**
  As we hit PMF and raise a round, this role can grow into:
  + •
    **Founding Engineer / Head of Engineering**
    , or
  + • Lead for
    **Applied AI / Agent Systems**

We'll be transparent about
**numbers, runway, and milestones from day 1**
, so you can make an informed decision about the risk/reward curve you're signing up for.

**How to Join the Quest**

If this sounds like the kind of risk/reward curve you want to ride:

**Send us:**

* • Your GitHub/portfolio, or 1–2 repos you're proud of
* • Any LLM/AI-powered project you've worked on (internal or side project)
* • 2–3 short paragraphs on:
  + – A system you've designed end-to-end, and
  + – Either: (a) how you'd design the retrieval pipeline for: "L-shape sofa under 45k, fabric, 84 inches, in stock in HSR store", or (b) how you'd measure lead leakage and WhatsApp-driven uplift for a furniture brand

Apply via EmailConnect on LinkedIn

We'll do a quick intro call, a deep-dive tech discussion, and then a short, paid trial project so you can see the real system before committing.

**Total timeline:**
Usually ~2–3 weeks from first call to offer, including a short paid trial project.

ChannelBlend welcomes individuals of all backgrounds. We're committed to crafting a place where builders, debuggers, and dreamers can do the best work of their careers – and have a real shot at changing how retail works in India and beyond.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
**Role:**
Business Development Specialist / GTM Consultant

**Location:**
Bengaluru, HSR Layout

**Experience:**
6 months – 1 year

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Recrivio**

Recrivio is a talent and trust infrastructure company helping businesses hire the right talent and build reliable, scalable teams. We support organizations through permanent recruitment, contract staffing, offshore team building, and technology-enabled background verification.

We work with growing startups, mid-sized businesses, and enterprises to simplify hiring, improve workforce agility, and build trust throughout the employee lifecycle.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a driven and result-oriented
**Business Development Specialist**
to support our growth by identifying potential clients, initiating conversations with decision-makers, generating qualified leads, and converting opportunities into business.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people, building relationships, researching businesses, and working towards measurable sales targets. You will work closely with the leadership and sales teams to build a strong pipeline and contribute directly to Recrivio’s revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead Generation & Prospecting:**
  Identify and research potential B2B clients across relevant industries using LinkedIn, databases, email, and other channels.
* **Outbound Sales:**
  Initiate conversations with prospective clients through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and follow-ups.
* **Client Acquisition:**
  Understand prospective clients’ business requirements and identify opportunities for Recrivio’s talent and workforce solutions.
* **Pipeline Management:**
  Maintain an organized database of leads, track conversations, manage follow-ups, and update CRM records regularly.
* **Meeting Generation:**
  Schedule discovery calls and meetings with HR leaders, Talent Acquisition Heads, founders, business leaders, and other relevant decision-makers.
* **Opportunity Management:**
  Qualify leads, understand hiring requirements, prepare initial proposals, and coordinate with internal teams to move opportunities forward.
* **Relationship Building:**
  Develop and maintain professional relationships with prospects and existing clients to create long-term business opportunities.
* **Sales Targets:**
  Work towards clearly defined weekly and monthly targets for outreach, qualified meetings, pipeline creation, and business conversion.
* **Market Research:**
  Track industry developments, identify prospective accounts, and share insights to improve outreach strategies and conversion rates.

* 6 months to 1 year of experience in business development, B2B sales, inside sales, lead generation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to interact with senior professionals and business decision-makers.
* Comfortable with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and persistent follow-ups.
* Good research skills and the ability to identify relevant prospects and understand their business needs.
* A target-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of measurable outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and maintain accurate records of sales activities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM tools and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is an advantage.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

**What We Look For**

* **Ownership:**
  You take responsibility for outcomes rather than just completing assigned activities.
* **Resilience:**
  You can handle rejection, maintain consistency, and keep improving your approach.
* **Communication:**
  You can articulate ideas clearly and hold professional conversations with prospective clients.
* **Execution:**
  You follow through on commitments and ensure that leads do not go unattended.
* **Learning Agility:**
  You actively seek feedback and apply it to improve your sales performance.

**Why Join Recrivio?**

* Skills: Excellent communication skills (fluency in English is required; proficiency in Hindi/Kannada is a plus). Creativity in approach, patience, and the ability to engage children in learning. Strong observational and reporting skills to document progress.

description:
**Job Type:**
Full-time, Permanent

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Industry:**
B2B Technology / Digital Marketing Agency

Bengaluru

About Us

Blufig is a full-service B2B marketing agency helping technology and enterprise brands achieve their digital growth goals. Having worked with 130+ brands, we aim to transform the B2B agency landscape through innovative, data-driven, and AI-powered marketing solutions.

We are looking for a versatile
**Content & Copywriter**
who can combine compelling storytelling with strategic messaging to create content that informs, engages, and converts. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in both content writing and copywriting, with the ability to simplify complex technology concepts and adapt their writing to different audiences, platforms, and brand voices.

Role Overview

You will manage end-to-end content and copy delivery across multiple client accounts, creating everything from SEO blogs and website content to landing pages, ad copy, email campaigns, social media content, case studies, and marketing collaterals.

You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, managing client feedback, maintaining quality standards, and using AI tools to improve research, ideation, writing, and editing workflows.

Key Responsibilities1. Content Writing & Copywriting

* Create high-quality content and compelling copy for websites, landing pages, blogs, SEO articles, LinkedIn, social media, email campaigns, advertisements, case studies, video scripts, presentations, and marketing collaterals.
* Write persuasive, audience-focused copy that supports brand awareness, lead generation, engagement, and conversions.
* Translate complex B2B technology products and services into clear, engaging, and benefit-driven messaging for business decision-makers.
* Develop content aligned with client objectives, target audiences, brand positioning, tone of voice, and marketing goals.
* Adapt writing styles across formats, industries, channels, and stages of the B2B buyer journey.

2. Content Strategy & Planning

* Understand content briefs, campaign objectives, audience personas, and business goals before developing content.
* Contribute to content strategies, editorial calendars, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks, and content distribution plans.
* Identify relevant topics, content angles, audience pain points, and storytelling opportunities.
* Align content with SEO fundamentals, search intent, and relevant keywords wherever required.

3. AI-Assisted Writing & Optimization

* Use AI writing tools and LLMs to support research, brainstorming, content outlines, first drafts, headline variations, and content repurposing.
* Create effective prompts to generate relevant, context-rich, and usable outputs.
* Review, edit, and humanize AI-assisted content to ensure originality, accuracy, clarity, brand consistency, and a natural writing style.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, vague, or AI-sounding language.
* Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that improve efficiency without compromising creativity or content quality.

4. Editing, Quality Control & Delivery

* Edit and proofread content for grammar, clarity, structure, tone, factual accuracy, and consistency.
* Conduct quality checks to ensure deliverables meet client requirements and brand guidelines.
* Manage revisions, stakeholder feedback, and approval cycles while maintaining high editorial standards.
* Ensure timely delivery of multiple content assignments across client accounts.
* Develop and follow content processes that improve quality, consistency, and workflow efficiency.

5. Collaboration & Client Coordination

* Work closely with content strategists, designers, digital marketers, SEO specialists, web developers, and account managers.
* Coordinate with clients on content briefs, feedback, revisions, and approvals for assigned accounts, where required.
* Incorporate feedback constructively and maintain clear communication throughout the content delivery process.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **2–5 years of relevant experience**
  in content writing, copywriting, or a combination of both.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in both long-form content and short-form, conversion-focused copywriting.
* A strong portfolio showcasing blogs, website content, landing pages, social media posts, email campaigns, ad copy, case studies, or other marketing assets.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, storytelling, and communication skills.
* Ability to simplify technical or complex concepts into clear, compelling, audience-focused messaging.
* Understanding of content strategy, audience intent, brand positioning, and marketing objectives.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Comfort working with feedback, ambiguity, and changing priorities in an agency environment.
* Practical experience using AI writing tools and LLMs for research, ideation, drafting, editing, and content optimization.
* Strong editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, specific, engaging, and aligned with brand voice.

**B2B technology, SaaS, enterprise, or digital marketing agency experience will be an advantage.**

Good to Have

* Knowledge of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, on-page optimization, and search intent.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms such as WordPress or HubSpot.
* Understanding of email marketing tools and campaign content.
* Exposure to ABM (Account-Based Marketing) and B2B demand-generation campaigns.
* Understanding of the B2B sales funnel and how content supports awareness, consideration, and conversion.
* Experience maintaining brand voice guidelines across multiple clients.

Benefits

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Health insurance for you and your family.
* Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.
* Exposure to diverse B2B technology brands and marketing challenges.
* A fast-paced, collaborative environment that encourages learning and innovation.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on client growth through content and copywriting.
